meta.name: detecting-broken-object-property-level-authorization
meta.description: Detect and test for OWASP API3:2023 Broken Object Property Level Authorization vulnerabilities including excessive data exposure and mass assignment attacks.

copy.tagline: 检测API对象属性级授权漏洞，防止数据泄露和批量赋值攻击
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你负责API安全测试或需要审计接口授权漏洞
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are responsible for API security testing or need to audit authorization vulnerabilities

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能检测 API 的过度数据暴露和批量赋值漏洞，比如找出响应中多余的敏感字段，或测试是否可注入未授权的属性。
howto.when: 当你进行 API 安全测试、渗透测试或威胁狩猎，需要检查 OWASP API3 漏洞时触发。

say.text: 扫描这个用户接口，看有没有暴露密码或角色字段。
say.note: Claude 会分析返回的字段并标记敏感项。

say.text: 测试 PUT 端点能否通过注入 is_admin=true 提权。
say.note: 它会发送测试请求并验证是否生效。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can detect excessive data exposure and mass assignment vulnerabilities in APIs, such as identifying sensitive fields in responses or testing if unauthorized properties can be injected.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need to check OWASP API3 vulnerabilities during API security testing, penetration testing, or threat hunting.

say_en.text: Scan this user endpoint for exposed password or role fields.
say_en.note: Claude will analyze response fields and flag sensitive ones.

say_en.text: Test the PUT endpoint for mass assignment by injecting is_admin=true.
say_en.note: It sends test requests and verifies if the injection works.
